sources.quote: Messier 105 or M105, also known as NGC 3379, is an elliptical galaxy 36.6 million light-years away in the equatorial constellation of Leo.

introduction.text: Its picture is the Sloan Digital Sky Survey's, with the Milky Way's foreground stars removed, standing as a flat picture that faces the Sun.

sources.label: Sloan Digital Sky Survey; color HiPS CDS/P/SDSS9/color by T. Boch (CDS), cut out by the CDS hips2fits service
Wikipedia, "Messier 105"
sources.quote: It is the biggest elliptical galaxy in the Messier catalogue that is not in the Virgo cluster.

optical.title: M105 in visible light
optical.summary: Visible-light image on a flat plane facing the Sun; nothing in it has depth.
